Summary:
Sriram Aalapati is a full-stack engineer focused on building scalable, product-oriented web applications using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Java, Spring Boot, and cloud-based delivery. He works across the stack on frontend experiences, APIs, database design, backend services, and deployment-ready architecture.

Core stack:
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, JWT, Spring Boot, Java
- Data and architecture: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, API design, system design, secure backend workflows
- Cloud and delivery: Azure, Git, GitHub, CI/CD, deployment practices

Notable work:
- Unified Data Processing Engine built with Spring Boot and MongoDB
- Business CRM and lead operations platform using React, Express, MySQL, and JWT
- AI healthcare assistant experience using React and Gemini API
- Productivity and finance dashboard with secure user workflows
